description: Authenticates the customer's domain for sending email through i-mailsend (Oracle OCI Email Delivery, eu-frankfurt-1): DKIM CNAME, SPF include merged into the existing SPF record, custom return path (bounce) CNAME, a monitoring-only DMARC policy. Used only when the domain has no DMARC record yet; otherwise the sending-nodmarc template is used. MX and website records are not touched. Version 2 adds the separate transactional sending subdomain tx.<domain> (its own DKIM CNAME, SPF include and return-path CNAME), so password resets and receipts never share reputation with newsletters.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector created for this domain in Oracle Email Delivery (e.g. em202610). The DKIM CNAME target is derived from it: <selector>.<fqdn>.dkim.fra1.oracleemaildelivery.com. txselector: the DKIM selector of the transactional subdomain tx.<fqdn> (e.g. emtx202610); its CNAME target is <txselector>.tx.<fqdn>.dkim.fra1.oracleemaildelivery.com.
